title: Source-locked nonlinear symmetry realization audit
question: Does the pre-soft-s RTK archive already contain an independently motivated, projectable, nonlinear local symmetry realization whose ADM/clock reduction implements the s6fZ null-direction redundancy and thereby fixes M proportional to u*u^T and source s parallel to u from one action?
required_for_REALIZATION_FOUND: explicit projectable nonlinear action, not only a quadratic toy
explicit local transformation law generating the kinetic null direction
same-action derivation of algebraic/potential degeneracy M*n=0
same-action derivation of source orthogonality s.n=0
closed or explicitly demonstrated full coupled constraint/DOF count

decision_rule.SOURCE_LOCKED_REALIZATION_FOUND_PASS_SCO: Only if one pre-soft-s archived construction satisfies every required item without new coefficients or reinterpretation.
decision_rule.NO_SOURCE_LOCKED_REALIZATION_FOUND_PASS_: If audited archived constructions fail at least one required item for documented structural reasons; retain the action-selection blocker.
decision_rule.AUDIT_INCOMPLETE_BLOCKED_SCOPED: If source material cannot be read or parent/source lock cannot be verified.

scope: Archive/source-lock theorem only; absence is not a no-go for a new independently motivated symmetry completion.
